summary: Persisted opt-in experiment flags associated with the same library preferences.

preferences.doc: The preferences node whose library owns these experiment settings.

flags.doc: Registered experiment ID to explicit preference; absence means off.

x-persistence: Store alongside the existing user settings, outside character and draft documents; session URL overrides never enter this stream.
x-registration: Generic experiment catalogue entries hold label and lazy import functions; a disabled experiment imports no feature module, view or renderer.
